scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @hideseek/shared build && concurrently -k -n server,web -c yellow,cyan "pnpm --filter @hideseek/server dev" "pnpm --filter @hideseek/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @hideseek/shared build && pnpm --filter @hideseek/web build && pnpm --filter @hideseek/server build
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
